item.title: Magical☆Prince
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Roll
  • 発売日: 2008-03-28
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: まじかる☆プリンス
  • 英語名: Magical☆Prince

あらすじ

The story takes place in a different world. Magic exists there and magic power is commonly used. Also, there is another world called the Magic World and the Magic King rules it. The main character is Yuki. Though he can’t use magic, he is put in a magic school. As expected, it is hard for him to keep up with other students. One day, when he has a rest in the park, a girl, Mira, suddenly tells him, “Please take over the throne.” He says yes without taking it seriously. On the next day, when he wakes up, she stands beside him. It seems the promise they made is true!! She says, “If you break a promise, you’ll be erased….” He reluctantly accepts it, but he will need to find a queen….

item.title: Sister Sister
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Roll
  • 発売日: 2006-12-15
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: シスターシスター
  • 英語名: Sister Sister

あらすじ

Yuu loves Yayoi, but he never tells her his love. One day, Hazuki, Yayoi’s younger sister, tells him her love toward him. He has no reason to say no, and they start to go out. On white day, he tries to hug her, but she runs away. The fact is Hazuki goes out with Yuu just to practice, and the ringleader is Yayoi. Finally, Yuu tells Yayoi his love, but she doesn’t answer it and says, “Why don’t three of us start from friends?” Their strange relationship starts….

item.title: School Festa
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Roll
  • 発売日: 2005-11-25
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: School Festa－スクールフェスタ－
  • 英語名: School Festa

あらすじ

Main character is announced by the student council that only top circles will survive and the rest will have to disband due to low activity. Protagonist was going to set a lazy tea drinking for the culture festival, but now changes plan in favor of coffee shop as it’s the fastest and easiest way to popularity. No one has any experience for that, so main character asks his childhood friend and another girl to devise the menu and actually cook. Will the circle survive after the festival?

  • 日本語名: おしかけおさなづま3(3乗）
  • 英語名: Oshikake Osanazuma 3

别名

  • Oshikake Osanazuma Sanjou

あらすじ

Main character is a high school student who lives alone after losing parents in a traffic accident. He finally regains joyfulness supported by his aunt, childhood friend and classmates. One day an he is visited by and old man claiming to be his grandfather and owner of a huge conglomerate. In order for protagonist to inherit this business, he needs to marry first. Grandfather chooses a bride candidate to live together in one house. However, protagonist’s friends rebel against this decision, so three more girls join them. Thus, a lively cohabitation of five people begins.
